video_title: Post Game Media Availability | Preseason | October 7, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on OKC's offensive principles and team-first culture
quotes.excerpt: we all play unselfish, we all want to see the other person win and succeed
quotes.quote: It comes back to pretty much our principles and what we have been working on in training camp, which is getting out fast and making the outlets, getting the ball up ahead. I think we all play unselfish, we all want to see the other person win and succeed. So when you have that type of atmosphere in the building, then it kind of just translates to the court.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on the Thunder offensive philosophy: We all play unselfish and want to see the other person succeed. When you have that type of atmosphere in the building it translates to the court.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Ousmane Dieng's impact and development
quotes.excerpt: it's exactly what we need and he's such a good dude
quotes.quote: It's awesome. It's exactly what we need and he's such a good dude and getting to know him and learning some Spanish from him too. It's been pretty cool to get to know him and play. He's a great player out there.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on Ousmane Dieng: It is awesome. He is exactly what we need and he is such a good dude. He is a great player out there.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the confidence of the team's young players
quotes.excerpt: it's really a tribute to this culture, being able to come in here and have this confidence
quotes.quote: It's amazing. It's really a hard thing to do coming in, especially to a team like this and to come in confident like that. So I really admire that and any questions I can answer for them, I love to. We got awesome vets that helped them out too, but it's really a tribute to this culture, being able to come in here and have this confidence to go out there and be themselves like they were in college.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on the confidence of the Thunder rookies: It is really a hard thing to do coming into a team like this and to come in confident like that. It is a tribute to this culture.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's versatile offensive game
quotes.excerpt: that's what makes him so special is being able to just beat you in so many different ways
quotes.quote: That's what makes him so special is being able to just beat you in so many different ways, whether it's off the dribble in the mid-range, three-point, to the rim. I think that makes it so hard to guard and he does a great job of being unselfish out there and when it's time to take over, we know he can.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: That is what makes him so special is being able to beat you in so many different ways. He does a great job of being unselfish and when it is time to take over we know he can.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on learning from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's off-court habits
quotes.excerpt: he really keeps it simple and I really admire that
quotes.quote: For me, it was seeing how he was just in the off-season in general, off the court kind of stuff. He really keeps it simple and I really admire that and how much of a family man he is. A lot of it was just kind of seeing I worked with his strength coach out there and being able to see just that on-court, off-court, what time we were waking up and being able to work out with him was really cool for me.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on learning from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He really keeps it simple and I admire that. Being able to work out with him was really cool for me.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the benefits of having secondary ball-handlers
quotes.excerpt: having someone to relieve that pressure off of him, bringing the ball up, it allows him
quotes.quote: For him, he's always guarded by the best player and so when he has to take the ball up, he's getting tired. He's playing a lot of minutes. So having someone to relieve that pressure off of him, bringing the ball up, it allows him to use that quickness and use the stamina he has to make the move stronger, whatever it is, and get to our spots and get to our play quicker for him in the half-court.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on the value of secondary playmaking: Having someone to relieve pressure off Shai allows him to use his stamina to make moves stronger and get to our spots quicker in the half-court.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on learning the Thunder's offensive system
quotes.excerpt: it's just allowed me to help learn the base principles of what they teach here
quotes.quote: I learned a lot of the offense of the endings of plays or new plays that we added in towards the end of the season last year and I never even knew like where the base play came from. And so being in training camp, it's just allowed me to help learn the base principles of what they teach here, offensively and defensively.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on his development: Being in training camp has allowed me to help learn the base principles of what they teach here offensively and defensively.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the team's supportive culture regarding shot selection
quotes.excerpt: it definitely gives you confidence when you miss a few in a row, your teammates and coaches
quotes.quote: It's amazing. I thank Mark for allowing me to take those shots and even when you take a bad one, he'll let you know. But it's something that they everybody knows is part of each each person's game and we all know each other's game, so we're going to encourage us to take those shots that we feel like we're going to make. It definitely gives you confidence when you miss a few in a row, your teammates and coaches are telling you take the next one, take the next open one and it gives you confidence to know that the next one's going to go in.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams on the team culture: It gives you confidence when you miss a few in a row and your teammates and coaches are telling you to take the next one. It gives you confidence to know the next one is going to go in.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the team's sharp start and player rotation
quotes.excerpt: I thought obviously I thought we were really sharp last night to start the game
quotes.quote: I thought obviously I thought we were really sharp last night to start the game, which is good to see coming out of a week of practice and then we had four guys start tonight that didn't play last night and it was much of the same. They were in a pretty good groove early, they had good pop, played together, let the game tell them what to do.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the preseason rotation: We had four guys start tonight that did not play last night and it was much of the same. They were in a pretty good groove early and played together.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the team's trust in Jalen Williams' playmaking
quotes.excerpt: it's interesting to see how the guys have responded to him
quotes.quote: He's done a great job of that. I think the guys have learned, it's interesting, you know, we haven't like emphasized a lot outside of our fundamentals and it's just interesting to see how the guys have responded to him. They've learned that he outlets the ball deep, so they're getting up the floor in the outlets, they're looking for him in the rolls, they understand the gravity of somebody that size that's got the hands he does.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams as a playmaker: The guys have learned that he outlets the ball deep and they understand the gravity of somebody that size who has the hands he does.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the rookies' professional approach to back-to-back games
quotes.excerpt: it's a sign of professional effort to get yourself ready to play in the second night
quotes.quote: I thought, like I said last night, he continues to calibrate and I thought both of those guys and the other rookie players, I mean, this is their first like back-to-back, probably of their lives. And so I thought they handled it pretty well. It's a sign of professional effort to get yourself ready to play in the second night and to give the same type of effort physically, mentally, so that was encouraging.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the rookies: This is their first back-to-back probably of their lives. It is a sign of professional effort to get yourself ready to play in the second night.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams' maturity and professionalism
quotes.excerpt: he's incredibly mature and professional, well beyond his years
quotes.quote: He's incredibly mature and professional, well beyond his years. He's very serious, he really thinks the game, understands the game and so he's got a presence to him because of that. He's an adult and that's going to serve him well. Professionalism is kind of an underrated quality that you need to have to be a good professional basketball player and he's got it. He's walking in the door with it.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams: He is incredibly mature and professional well beyond his years. He is an adult and that is going to serve him well.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams' defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: he's got an electric motor that really is contagious inside the team
quotes.quote: He was awesome. It was just great to see him out there playing with the confidence and aggression that he did on both ends of the floor. He's got an electric motor that really is contagious inside the team and you really feel it when he's on the court on both ends of the court.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams: He has an electric motor that really is contagious inside the team and you really feel it when he is on the court on both ends.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams' off-season conditioning
quotes.excerpt: the invisible work shows up and he did a lot of invisible work in between
quotes.quote: It's just a testament, the invisible work shows up and he did a lot of invisible work in between the end of Summer League and the start of training camp to get himself in a position to play well. Your impact isn't felt if you're not in great shape and no one's in 10 out of 10 shape in the beginning of training camp like this, you build to that over the course of the season.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on conditioning: The invisible work shows up. Your impact is not felt if you are not in great shape and you build to that over the course of the season.
